about_the_game:
Escape, hide, and hunt within the infinite maze of the Backrooms.
Backrooms: Prop Hunt blends the unsettling atmosphere of liminal spaces with the chaotic fun of classic prop-hunt gameplay.


Transform into furniture, equipment, or random objects scattered throughout eerie, yellow-lit rooms.
🟢 Do you hide… or do you hunt?


Whether you’re hiding in plain sight as an everyday object or tracking down cleverly disguised opponents, every match delivers tense, unpredictable moments.


Authentic Backrooms Atmosphere + Regular Content Updates
Explore unsettling liminal environments with infinite corridors, buzzing lights, and creeping tension.
New rooms, props, modes, and improvements to keep the experience fresh.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ PRO 7985WX Processor (3.20 GHz up to 5.10 GHz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX™ 4080 16GB GDDR6
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Disguise yourself as everyday objects, hide in plain sight or hunt down what doesn’t belong. It’s being the last object left alive. The most anticipated Prop Hunt experience of the year awaits (as voted by the Backrooms Research Unit).
